Title: Withdrawing with a hand size of 0

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
The rulebook state that :
>
> Withdrawing from the Game :
> You can also end your participation in the game by declaring your intent to withdraw from it. If you have exhausted your library and begin your turn with less than a full hand, you have the option to withdraw from the game.
>
If I have exhausted my library and an effective hand size of 0 (due for example to a lot of gehena cards). My understanding is that I can't withdraw for the game.

Correct ?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
